# NEW 2026-11-21 v8.5 Part B3 (Slot 67=heg): 12-Major AI Strategic Ecology & Dynamic Anti-Hegemon Layer (oe_mai_ / oe_heg_ai_). Generated by gen_majors_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Verified EU5 1.4.9 schema: days_between_checks, actor_trigger, recipient_trigger, recipient_priority,
# pause_trigger, cancel_trigger, improve_relation, improve_relation_limit, antagonise, country_relations, max_allowed.
# STRICT RULE: Every actor_trigger requires is_ai = yes & is_rebel_country = no.

# 1a. BYZ: cultivate Orthodox Balkan / Black Sea defensive ties during early survival crisis.
oe_mai_byz_orthodox_defensive_ties = {
    days_between_checks = 360

    actor_trigger = {
        is_ai = yes
        is_rebel_country = no
        tag = BYZ
        is_subject = no
        OR = {
            has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_fate_of_the_phoenix
            current_year <= 1410
        }
    }

    recipient_trigger = {
        scope:recipient = {
            is_subject = no
            religion = religion:orthodox
            NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
            NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
            NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:actor } }
            capital ?= {
                OR = {
                    region = region:balkan_region
                    region = region:anatolia_region
                    region = region:caucasus_region
                }
            }
        }
    }

    recipient_priority = {
        add = 45
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = {
                    is_neighbor_of = scope:actor
                }
            }
            add = 20
        }
    }

    pause_trigger = {
        scope:actor = { at_war = yes }
    }

    cancel_trigger = {
        OR = {
            scope:actor = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:recipient } }
            scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
            scope:recipient = { is_subject = yes }
        }
    }

    improve_relation = yes
    improve_relation_limit = 120

    country_relations = {
        alliance = yes
    }

    max_allowed = 2
}

    recipient_priority = {
        add = 70

    pause_trigger = {
        scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
    }

    cancel_trigger = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { oe_weu_fra_pact_active = yes }
            NOT = { country_exists = c:FRA }
            scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
        }
    }

    improve_relation = yes
    improve_relation_limit = 120
    country_relations = {
        alliance = yes

    max_allowed = 1
}

    recipient_priority = {
        add = 50
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = {
                    OR = {
                        tag = KOR
                        tag = TIB
                    }
                }

            add = 25
        }
    }

    pause_trigger = {
        scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
    }

    cancel_trigger = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { scope:recipient = { is_subject_of = scope:actor } }
            scope:recipient = { "opinion(scope:actor)" >= 150 }
        }
    }

    improve_relation = yes
    improve_relation_limit = 150
    max_allowed = 2
}

        }

        OR = {

# ==============================================================================
# Dynamic Anti-Hegemon Counter-Balancing Diplomacy (Slot 67 = heg; Rule #10 gated)
# ==============================================================================

# Anti-Hegemon Behavior 2a: CROSS-CAMP COALITION ALLIANCE among threatened majors sharing an active hegemon.
oe_heg_ai_coalition_ally = {
    days_between_checks = 360

    actor_trigger = {
        oe_heg_ai_is_threatened_major = yes
    }

    recipient_trigger = {
        scope:recipient = {
            NOT = { this = scope:actor }
            NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
            NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:actor } }
            oe_heg_ai_is_threatened_peer = yes
            "opinion(scope:actor)" < 130
        }
    }

    recipient_priority = {
        add = 65
        if = {
            limit = { oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_high = yes }
            add = 30
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = {
                    has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target
                    trigger_if = {
                        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target }
                        is_neighbor_of = global_var:oe_heg_ai_target
                    }
                }
            }
            add = 20
        }
    }

    pause_trigger = {
        scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
    }

    cancel_trigger = {
        OR = {
            oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_off = yes
            NOT = { oe_heg_ai_is_active = yes }
            scope:actor = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:recipient } }
            scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
            scope:recipient = { is_subject = yes }
        }
    }

    improve_relation = yes
    improve_relation_limit = 130
    country_relations = {
        alliance = yes
    }
    max_allowed = 2
}

# Anti-Hegemon Behavior 2b: ANTAGONISE the cached global hegemon.
oe_heg_ai_antagonise_hegemon = {
    days_between_checks = 360

    actor_trigger = {
        oe_heg_ai_is_threatened_major = yes
    }

    recipient_trigger = {
        scope:recipient = {
            has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target }
                global_var:oe_heg_ai_target ?= this
            }
            NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:actor } }
            NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:actor }
        }
    }

    recipient_priority = {
        add = 75
        if = {
            limit = { oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_high = yes }
            add = 25
        }
    }

    pause_trigger = {
        scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
    }

    cancel_trigger = {
        OR = {
            oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_off = yes
            NOT = { oe_heg_ai_is_active = yes }
            scope:actor = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:recipient } }
            scope:recipient = { is_subject_of = scope:actor }
        }
    }

    antagonise = yes
    max_allowed = 1
}
